# Start with the synthetic fixture
Run **Run report manually** in n8n. The report summarizes statuses from one page and ignores historical pause reasons on browsers that are running.

To inspect a real workspace, create a **Header Auth** credential in n8n with header `Authorization` and value `Bearer YOUR_WORKSPACE_API_KEY`. Select it on **List real browsers**, then wire **Run report manually → List real browsers → Summarize pause reasons** in place of **Load sample browsers**. Keep the workflow inactive until you choose how to run it.

`hasAnotherPage` indicates a partial view. Read current usage before deciding whether a browser can resume. [Cloudbrowser REST API reference](https://cloudbrowser.tv/docs/api)
